sections.overview: This freshwater cichlid occurs in the upper Negro and upper Orinoco basins.
sections.identification: FishBase reports up to 18 cm total length and about 20 cm in height.
sections.habitat: It inhabits tropical rivers, including the Inírida and Atabapo tributaries.
sections.diet: The species summaries consulted here do not specify its diet.
sections.behavior: FishBase describes it as benthopelagic and non-migratory.
sections.reproduction: The references consulted do not detail its reproduction.
sections.ecology: Its range links the upper Orinoco with the Amazon’s upper Negro drainage.
sections.conservation: FishBase gives a global Least Concern category (2020). Colombia’s 2012 Red Book lists it as Vulnerable nationally.
